question: A, B, E, G, P, L and M are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Only L sits between A and P. P sits third to the left of E. G sits to the immediate left of E. B is not an immediate neighbour of P. Who sits fourth to the left of M?
solution:
Given: A, B, E, G, P, L and M are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1) P sits third to the left of E.

2) G sits to the immediate left of E.
